product.title: Deluxe Las Vegas Helicopter Night Flight with VIP Transportation
product.description: See the Las Vegas Strip from the air on a nighttime helicopter flight designed for travelers who want premium logistics and a skyline-first perspective. This deluxe option includes VIP transportation and a narrated route over the Strip's signature landmarks, including the Bellagio fountains, Allegiant Stadium, and Downtown's Fremont Street corridor.
highlights: Night helicopter flight over the illuminated Las Vegas Strip
VIP hotel transportation for a smoother preflight experience
Aerial views of Bellagio fountains, High Roller, and Fremont Street
Live pilot narration focused on major landmarks
inclusions: Round-trip VIP transportation from select Las Vegas hotels
additionalInfo: All passengers must present a valid photo ID.
Flight routes may vary by air-traffic control restrictions.
Guests should reconfirm pickup details after booking.

start.description: Hotel pickup and drop-off are available from select Las Vegas Strip and Downtown properties; pickup windows vary by hotel and flight time.

itineraryItems.title: VIP pickup in Las Vegas
itineraryItems.description: Begin with coordinated pickup from select hotels before transfer to the terminal.

itineraryItems.title: Las Vegas Strip helicopter flight
itineraryItems.description: Fly over the Strip at night with views of resorts, attractions, and the downtown glow.

itineraryItems.title: Return transfer
itineraryItems.description: After landing, return to your original pickup zone.

faqs.question: How long is the helicopter flight itself?
faqs.answer: The air segment is approximately 12 to 15 minutes, with total experience time around 3 hours including transfers.

faqs.question: Is hotel pickup included?
faqs.answer: Yes, VIP transportation is included from select Las Vegas pickup points.
